verification.note: Refresh of 18 Oct 2026 under the rule that level A needs the instrument's own text or an official register. Stored and read: NIA's copy of the draft guideline (nia.or.kr, PDF, 71 pages, stored 12 Oct 2026 and unchanged when the archiver checked it on 18 Oct 2026; read through pdftotext, as the PDF's own text layer is garbled) and NIA's notice of 22 January 2026 distributing the AI Basic Act guidelines, stored in this run. The cover image shows the title, '2026. 1' and the logos of MSIT and ETRI, but the cover has no text layer, so the month cannot be quoted, and no page of the text gives a date for the guideline; the publication date therefore rests on NIA's notice (its date and the file name 260122), an announcement that counts as alt-official, and the record is level B. The PDF confirms the draft marking, the Article 32 and Decree Article 24 basis, the three criteria, the draft notification with its blank number, the compute-calculation methods, the chapter structure, the three-month submission rule and the 24-hour, 7-day and 15-day incident reports. The running header on every page misprints the title as '인공지능 안정성 확보 가이드라인'; the notice's file name gives the title correctly. MSIT as author rests on the cover logos and on the guideline's purpose of explaining MSIT's notification; no text names it as the author. The KOSA help desk's later version (draft notification No. 2026-126 of February 2026, title '최첨단 인공지능 안전성 확보 가이드라인'), on which date_last_updated '2026-02' and the KOSA part of issuing_body rest, could not be stored: the site's robots.txt does not allow automated downloads, and sw.or.kr is listed as not official. The archiver flagged NIA's notice for review because it barely mentions the guideline's title; it is the notice that distributes the guideline files.

status.quote: 이 가이드라인(안)은 전문가, 실무자, 그리고 다양한 이해관계자의 의견을 모아, 해외 동향과 인공지능 기술의 발전, 서비스 형태 등을 종합적으로 반영해 작성 중인 자료입니다.
